The background is a brightly lit indoor space with neutral-colored walls. (2) The hands begin to move closer together, and the person interlocks the extended pinky fingers of both hands. (3) The person then adjusts their thumbs and the interlocked fingers to form a cohesive heart shape with both hands combined. A pink heart-shaped graphic with the Japanese word '好き!!' appears as a stylized overlay on the left, emphasizing the successful completion of the heart gesture.
